title: Improve wizard governance and release evidence flow
outOfScope: Changing release tag history or provider-side published releases.
Changing the six accepted improvement goals into new product features.
Lowering quality, coverage, or release hard gates.
Adding semantic risk claims beyond repository-evidenced classifications.

sources.reason: Observed issues and accepted improvements from the completed wizard run.
Current Work Item creation and collision behavior.

riskAssessment.reason: Changes are deterministic repository workflow tooling and evidence projection; hard gates, exact-SHA selection, and immutable release history remain unchanged.

executionDecision.reason: User explicitly accepted all six improvements and authorized completion of the governed Work Item lifecycle.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Issue-log coverage includes structured records and a generated final overview for WI13-WI23, with no unresolved required issue hidden from the completion claim.
ai-start rejects or deterministically disambiguates an archive Work Item ID collision before creating active files, with a regression test and actionable output.
Release waiting reports the exact source SHA, dependent run IDs, current state, timeout window, and diagnostic command without weakening exact-SHA selection.
Verification exposes focused checks for changed scope and a separate full gate; PR and release gates continue to require full strict verification.
Risk readiness preserves evidence-derived risk levels and represents explicit user authorization separately from risk classification.
Post-publication provider evidence can be bound into the final Task Outcome/Summary with release URL, tag SHA, asset digest, workflow run, and Quick Install evidence.
The archived Summary records focused regression results, full quality and AI Cockpit results, documentation evidence, PR/merge/archive/close commands, and final clean-base equality.
guidelines: Keep hard release and quality gates fail-closed; optimization must not weaken required proof.
Preserve append-only issue and outcome evidence; later records may resolve but never rewrite historical findings.
Keep provider credentials, machine-specific paths, and secrets out of repository evidence.

intent.problem: The completed wizard run succeeded but required manual recovery for issue-log coverage, Work Item archive collision, long release waits, repeated verification, risk wording, and final publication evidence.
constraints: Use one governed Work Item with one PR and preserve the existing lifecycle order.
Do not rewrite historical issue records or release tags.
Do not lower hard gates or report provider publication without provider evidence.
Use standard-library-compatible repository tooling unless an existing locked dependency already provides the behavior.
intent.rationale: Convert the observed manual recovery paths into deterministic, testable workflow behavior so the next serial run is shorter, more complete, and easier to audit.

rawUserRequest: 接受建议，继续完成1-6全部。
